consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking the yes/no 'does the player have the required quantity of the quest item?' that gates quest completion (the HUD only mirrors this verdict).
scope: items reachable via crafting_inventory() (carried PLUS items within crafting reach nearby), not merely the character's own wielded/worn/inventory.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — returns a bool by testing u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback), i.e. an engine-computed completion predicate over the crafting inventory's reach.
divergence: The required item sits in a container on an adjacent tile within crafting reach but is NOT carried: real is_complete() returns true (crafting_inventory sees it), while a re-derivation from avatar.carried_items[] (wielded/worn/inventory only) returns false — wrong-scope predicate exposed.
